videos.title: I Built a VPN That Anyone Can Use for Free!
videos.summary: Mike shows the public Aegis VPN Linux app, imports free Proton test server configs, and checks DNS leak protection, a kill switch, and a speed test.
videos.heading: I built a VPN that Anyone can use for free

videos.title: I Built My Own VPN Instead of Paying for One!
videos.summary: Mike uses ChatGPT and Claude Code in Herdr to start Aegis VPN, a WireGuard client for Linux and Windows, then compiles an early Tauri and Rust build.
videos.heading: I built my own VPN instead of paying for one

videos.title: I Got Tired of Outdated Software So I Built This App (Windows & Linux)
videos.summary: UpdateForge is a free open-source Windows and Linux package manager GUI — update all your apps in one click across apt, npm, and Cargo (Winget/Chocolatey-style workflow). Built with Claude Code. UniGetUI alternative with a self-learning recommended apps tab.
videos.heading: I got Tired of Outdated Software so I built this app (Windows & Linux)

videos.title: Your Business Is Invisible to AI Search (Here's the Fix)
videos.summary: Mike uses Rank Prompt to scan VisiScan's AI visibility, then connects the Rank Prompt MCP in Claude Code to fix pages and draft outreach. Rank Prompt sponsored it.
videos.heading: Your business is invisible to AI search (here's the fix)

videos.title: Let GrokBot Find And Apply To Jobs For You
videos.summary: Grok Bot tutorial: use GrokBot as an AI job search agent that finds remote jobs, optimizes your resume for ATS, and helps automate job applications. Full setup — job app agent, sub-agents, ATS resume download, remote + salary filters.
videos.heading: Let GrokBot find and Apply to jobs for you

videos.title: Grok Bot Credits: Why They Run Out So Fast (And How To Fix It)
videos.summary: See why GrokBot credits disappear so fast and the settings and prompts used to cut usage, from pausing routines to moving them into their own bot.
videos.heading: GrokBot credit usage: why it drains and how to save

videos.title: Herdr On Windows Is Better Than I Expected!
videos.summary: Explore Herdr on Windows: PowerShell installation, themes, a credit-usage mod and Insights. The walkthrough also tours an Update Forge app build.
videos.heading: Herdr on Windows: Installation, Themes, Mods and Usage
